data.name: FrequencyUnavailable
data.value: Effective frequency: unavailable. Nominal frequency is not an instantaneous reading.

data.name: PhysicalDefinition
data.value: Used = usable physical total − available. Available includes reusable pages; it is not only free RAM.

data.name: ProcessMemoryDefinition
data.value: Working set includes private and shared resident pages. Private commit is committed virtual memory; do not add it to physical RAM. Source: K32GetProcessMemoryInfo.

data.name: MonitoringLimitations
data.value: CPU: active-time deltas from GetSystemTimes; may differ from Task Manager frequency-adjusted utility. Low usage does not rule out a single-core bottleneck. Gaps are not filled. Collection pauses when leaving this page or minimizing. There is no memory cleaning.

data.name: CpuTemperatureUnavailable
data.value: CPU temperature: unavailable. The native APIs used do not provide a reliable Ryzen sensor. No additional driver was installed.

data.name: GpuDefinitions
data.value: Source: NVML installed with the driver. VRAM is reported allocation, not activity or DXGI budget; reserved fields remain separate and the percentage is allocated / capacity. WDDM accounting depends on Windows and the driver. RTX 5060 power is a driver average of approximately 1 s. Memory clock is not effective transfer rate. Fan speed is not RPM; 0% may be fan-stop. Low utilization does not diagnose a bottleneck. Timestamps indicate local acquisition; internal sampling windows may differ.

data.name: MonitoringFocus
data.value: CPU, RAM, GPU and VRAM usage — not FPS. The — symbol means no reading.

data.name: CollectorDetails

data.name: RamFindingNoSustainedLowAvailability
data.value: No sustained low availability in this window

data.name: RamEvidence
data.value: Observed window: {0} s (up to 60 s) · Continuous low availability: {1} s

data.name: RamAdviceLow
data.value: Little RAM remained available for at least 30 seconds. Review open applications and compare the same situation with your game running. This signal alone does not demonstrate stuttering or identify its cause.

data.name: RamAdviceUnavailable
data.value: Waiting for valid capacity and availability readings. Observation restarts after failures, pauses or gaps longer than 2.5 seconds.

data.name: RamAdviceObserve
data.value: Keep this page open for at least 30 seconds during the situation you want to investigate. The finding applies only to the observed window; it neither predicts a game’s demand nor proves waste.

data.name: RamConfidenceObserved
data.value: Direct evidence of low availability under the local rule. Confidence about its cause and gaming impact: insufficient.

data.name: RamConfidenceLimited
data.value: Scope: observed physical availability. There is not enough evidence to recommend changes to Windows.

data.name: RamMethod
data.value: Local rule RAM-AVAIL-001 v1: low availability requires at most 10% of RAM and at most 1 GiB available continuously for 30 s. Very low: at most 5% and 512 MiB for 30 s. These are Lotus triage criteria, not official Windows limits. Missing readings never become zero.

data.name: RamCacheExplanation
data.value: Available does not mean only free RAM. Windows can repurpose standby/cache pages; cache occupancy does not prove mismanagement. Forcibly emptying working sets can cause new page faults when data is accessed again.

data.name: RamLimits
data.value: This version does not measure system commit, disk paging, compressed memory or per-application usage. It does not identify leaks or gaming bottlenecks. No page file, cache, process or Windows setting is changed.

data.name: FaqSafetyQuestion
data.value: Does Lotus change Windows during analysis?

data.name: FaqSafetyAnswer
data.value: No. Analysis reads sensors and shows the result. Future changes will be presented for your confirmation before anything is applied.

data.name: FaqSolutionsQuestion
data.value: Why is there no fix-everything button yet?

data.name: FaqSolutionsAnswer
data.value: Each adjustment needs an identified cause, a safe way to apply it and a check of the result. Automatic actions will be added in stages, with confirmation and rollback when possible.

data.name: FaqAmbientQuestion
data.value: Why does the background sometimes stop moving?

data.name: FaqAmbientAnswer
data.value: The background follows Lotus’s Reduce animations setting and the Windows motion preference. It also pauses when the window loses focus or is minimized. The brand uses its own motion policy.
